title: Continuous Eligibility and Postpartum Coverage Protections
content:
## Continuous eligibility — Medicaid Managed Care Membership

**Clause.** In a Medicaid Managed Care Membership category with continuous eligibility, coverage cannot end for ineligible income, for a procedural reason (no response to renewal) or for premium non-payment before the category's continuous eligibility months have passed from the coverage start date or the latest renewal approval, whichever is later. In Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, coverage continues through the category's postpartum coverage months after the month the pregnancy ends, regardless of income changes. Termination because the member moved out of state, died, disenrolled voluntarily or changed health plans is allowed at any time in every category.

A category whose continuous eligibility months are zero has no continuous eligibility period; a category whose postpartum coverage months are zero has no postpartum guarantee.

### Where the period starts

The continuous eligibility period runs from the later of two dates:

- the coverage start date of the membership, and
- the date of the latest renewal approval.

The months are counted from whichever of those two dates is later.

### Termination reasons while the period runs

| Reason the membership would end | Inside a running continuous eligibility period | Outside it, or in a category without one |
|---|---|---|
| Income no longer within the category limit | Cannot end coverage | Governed by the other membership rules |
| Procedural end (renewal not returned) | Cannot end coverage | Governed by the other membership rules |
| Premium non-payment | Cannot end coverage | Governed by the other membership rules |
| Moved out of state | Allowed at any time | Allowed at any time |
| Deceased | Allowed at any time | Allowed at any time |
| Voluntary disenrollment | Allowed at any time | Allowed at any time |
| Change to another health plan | Allowed at any time | Allowed at any time |

### Postpartum coverage

In Prairie Ridge Pregnancy Care, coverage continues through the postpartum coverage months counted after the month in which the pregnancy ends. An income change during that time does not end it.

### Hypothetical illustrations

Hypothetical inputs only, for a category with 12 continuous eligibility months:

- Coverage started on 1 February; the latest renewal approval was earlier than that. The period is counted from 1 February, and during the 12 months that follow, coverage cannot end for income, for a procedural reason or for premium non-payment.
- Coverage started some years ago and the latest renewal approval was 15 September. The later date is 15 September, so the 12 months are counted from that approval.
- In either case, a report that the member has moved out of state can end the membership at once, because that reason is allowed at any time.
